newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apartment Investment upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apartment Investment upgraded.

text.p: -- McDonald & Co analyst Jill Holup said Tuesday she upgraded Apartment Investment and Management Co to a buy from hold.
-- In a report, Holup said Apartment Investment was downgraded to a hold in May based on some property inspections.

-- "Subsequent to our rating change, we believe the company has rectified that situation by...selling those assets which caused us the most concern, and...appointing senior members of management to monitor the company's most challenging assets," she said.
-- In addition, Apartment Investment recently announced two separate transactions that together will add as much as $0.20 a share to 1997 funds from operations.
-- Apartment Investment shares were down 1/8 at 20-3/8.
